indicators.label: Gini index
indicators.description: Gini index of taxable income (0 = perfect equality, 1 = one person has everything).

indicators.label: Top 1% income share
indicators.description: Share of total taxable income received by the top 1% of taxpayers.

indicators.description: Share of taxpayers declaring less than €15,000.

indicators.label: Taxpayers earning €15,000–28,000
indicators.description: Share of taxpayers declaring between €15,000 and €28,000.

indicators.label: Taxpayers earning €28,000–50,000
indicators.description: Share of taxpayers declaring between €28,000 and €50,000.

indicators.label: Taxpayers earning over €50,000
indicators.description: Share of taxpayers declaring more than €50,000.
